source: Things to do in Raleigh this Weekend! — Thingstodo919

events.name: First Friday
events.tagline: A free monthly self-guided tour showcasing Downtown Raleigh's best art, music, and food.
events.description: First Friday is celebrated on the first Friday of each month throughout Downtown Raleigh to showcase the city's creative community with open galleries, live music, and food vendors[1][3]. It is a free self-guided tour where walkable venues generally operate from 6 to 9 p.m.[4].

events.name: Rockstar Devi Sri Prasad Live - Euphoria 2026
events.tagline: An unforgettable musical night featuring Rockstar Devi Sri Prasad in Raleigh.
events.venue: Memorial Auditorium at Martin Marietta Center for the Performing Arts
events.description: Rockstar Devi Sri Prasad brings his electrifying live performance to Raleigh for Euphoria 2026 at the Memorial Auditorium on July 3, 2026.

events.name: Movie Night: Independence Day
events.tagline: Outdoor screening of the 90s blockbuster Independence Day with family activities and food trucks.
events.description: Grab lawn chairs and blankets for an outdoor screening of Independence Day at Downtown Cary Park, featuring pre-screening activities and food trucks.

events.name: America’s 250th Anniversary Patriotic Celebration
events.tagline: Celebrate America’s Semi-Quincentennial with an evening of patriotic pride, history, and musical excitement.
events.description: The Cary Town Band presents a concert guiding audiences through 250 years of American history with patriotic music and narration by guest Mark Schreiner[1][9].

events.name: Wake Forest Fireworks Spectacular 2026
events.tagline: Join 15,000 neighbors for Wake Forest's biggest fireworks show of the year, featuring live music, food trucks, and family fun.
events.scheduleNote: Fri 5:30 PM–11:00 PM · Gates 5:30 PM · Fireworks ~9:30 PM
events.description: The annual Independence Day celebration features a live concert by The Swingin' Medallions, roaming performers, food trucks, and a spectacular fireworks display at Husky Stadium on the Heritage High School campus.

events.name: Apex Fireworks Frenzy
events.tagline: Celebrate America's 250th with a parade, drone show, and spectacular fireworks in Apex.
events.scheduleNote: Fri 4:30–10 PM · Drone show ~8:45 PM · Fireworks ~9:30 PM (tentative, weather-dependent)
events.description: Apex Fireworks Frenzy is a family-friendly Independence Day celebration featuring food trucks, games, a community Parade of Wheels, a fire department splashdown, a unique 200-drone light show, and a spectacular fireworks display.

events.name: Raleigh + Rostock 25th Anniversary Reception
events.tagline: Celebrate 25 years of international friendship between Raleigh and Rostock at this special Sister City Anniversary Reception.
events.address: 500 E Davie St Suite 160, Raleigh, NC 27601
events.description: Join community leaders and guests for an evening honoring visiting delegation guests from Rostock, Germany, at the Transfer Co. Ballroom in Downtown Raleigh.

events.name: Cary July 3rd Celebration 2026
events.tagline: A party 250 years in the making celebrating the old USA with games, mist zones, arts, and food.
events.description: This free Independence Day Weekend event features patriotic activities, roaming entertainment, trivia, food trucks, and a special screening of the movie 'Independence Day' at Downtown Cary Park[1][2].

events.name: First Friday Market & Movie Night: Hamilton
events.tagline: Free outdoor movie night with food trucks, a local market, live music, and lawn games in Downtown Raleigh.
events.scheduleNote: Fri 5–9 PM · Market & Food Trucks 5–9 PM · Live Music 5:30 PM · Movie 6 PM
events.description: Join this family-friendly outdoor event at Moore Square for a screening of Hamilton (2020), local vendors, food trucks, live music, and free lawn games.

events.name: Garner Independence Day Celebration
events.tagline: Celebrate America's 250th with the NC Symphony, food, and the best fireworks show in the Triangle.
events.scheduleNote: Fri 5–10 PM · NC Symphony 8:30–9:30 PM · Fireworks approx. 9:30 PM
events.description: The Garner Independence Day Celebration features a headlining performance by the North Carolina Symphony, local food vendors, a Kids' Zone with games and crafts, and a fireworks show immediately following the concert.

events.name: Stars, Stripes & Signatures
events.tagline: An upscale Independence Eve celebration for the grown and sophisticated.
events.description: Stars, Stripes & Signatures is an upscale Independence Eve event at The Haymaker in downtown Raleigh, offering a refined social environment for professionals to celebrate the holiday weekend in a sophisticated setting.

events.name: Cary Tennis Classic 2026
events.tagline: Elite professional tennis on outdoor hard courts featuring ATP Challenger and ITF Women's World Tennis Tour action.
events.scheduleNote: Fri 9:00 AM · Sat 10:00 AM · Sun 2:00 PM
events.freeNote: Tickets start at $15; Friday single match tickets $26–$61
events.description: The 12th annual Cary Tennis Classic is a professional tennis tournament held on outdoor hard courts in Cary, NC, featuring both men's ATP Challenger and women's ITF World Tennis Tour matches from June 29 to July 5, 2026.

events.name: Zinchouse Independence Day Celebration
events.tagline: Celebrate Independence Day early with live music, food trucks, and fireworks at a free 21+ party.
events.scheduleNote: Fri 12–11 PM · Gates open 12 PM · Music 4–10 PM · Fireworks 9 PM
events.description: The Zinchouse Independence Day Celebration is a free, 21+ event on Friday, July 3, 2026, featuring live music from The Band Next Door and Love Tribe, local food trucks, craft cocktails, wine, brews, and a fireworks show at ZincHouse Winery & Brewery in Durham.

events.name: ADF Presents: Mark Morris Dance Group and Music Ensemble
events.tagline: A vibrant celebration of iconic American composers through dance and live music.
events.scheduleNote: Fri 7:30 PM · Sat 7:30 PM · Sun 12:00 PM (Children's Matinee 5:00 PM)
events.description: The Mark Morris Dance Group and Music Ensemble returns to the American Dance Festival with Dances to American Music, featuring works by Gottschalk, Gershwin, and Bob Wills.

events.name: Gina Brillon
events.tagline: Puerto Rican comedian and America's Got Talent finalist brings sharp, hilarious storytelling to Raleigh Improv.
events.description: Gina Brillon, a Bronx-born Puerto Rican actress and comedian, performs her signature stand-up at Raleigh Improv on July 2–3, 2026, with shows at 7 PM.

events.name: DG the Artist / JEYVØ
events.tagline: Alternative hip-hop double bill with cubic vibes at Kings Raleigh.
events.description: This concert features a unique double bill showcasing DG the Artist and JEYVØ, bringing together fans of alternative hip-hop for a night of music and cubic vibes during the Rubik's North American Championship.

events.name: Excitable – The Def Leppard Tribute & '84 – A Tribute to Van Halen
events.tagline: Two iconic arena rock tributes collide for one night of 1980s guitar anthems in downtown Raleigh.
events.description: Excitable, a Def Leppard tribute band from Atlanta, recreates the arena rock sound of the 1980s alongside '84, a Van Halen tribute, at Lincoln Theatre in Raleigh on July 3, 2026.

events.name: First Friday Community Improv Jam
events.tagline: Join a free monthly improv jam with potluck and open mic in Downtown Raleigh.
events.scheduleNote: Fri 7–9:30 PM · Potluck at 7 PM, Jam & Open Mic at 7:30 PM
events.description: A free monthly community improv jam featuring potluck, open mic, and improv games for adults 18+ at Leela Improv Theatre in Downtown Raleigh.

events.name: First Friday at The Davie with Kerry Long
events.tagline: Skip the couch and enjoy live covers and originals by Kerry Long at The Davie.
events.description: Kerry Long performs a mix of covers and originals at The Davie for First Friday in downtown Raleigh, offering free admission and cold drinks.

events.name: FoundiT w/ Pnltybx, Manic Third Planet
events.tagline: Three distinct bands deliver a high-energy night of rock music in Raleigh's local scene.
events.venue: The Pour House Music Hall & Record Shop
events.description: This concert brings together FoundiT, Pnltybx, and Manic Third Planet for a high-energy rock performance at The Pour House in Raleigh on July 3, 2026.

events.name: Fusebox with The Dead-Heavy alt Rock Experience
events.tagline: A cover band night of heavy alt rock featuring The Deads as special guests
events.description: Fusebox hosts a heavy alt rock cover band night on July 3, 2026, with The Deads as special guests at Slim's Dive Bar in downtown Raleigh.

events.name: Glitter Hour - Amateur Drag Competition
events.tagline: A monthly open-call drag competition that gives queer people the space to connect.
events.description: Glitter Hour is a monthly open-call drag competition and three-time Raleigh Readers' Choice Award recipient for Favorite Nightlife Stage Event, rescheduled for Friday, July 3, 2026 at 9 PM.

events.name: Amateur Talent Show
events.tagline: First Friday talent show at Legends Nightclub hosted by Chloe Cassidy
events.description: Monthly First Friday Amateur Talent Show at Legends Nightclub in Downtown Raleigh, hosted by Chloe Cassidy, featuring drag, dancing, and local performers starting at 11pm.

events.name: Capitol 250: NC Freedom Fest
events.tagline: Celebrate America's 250th birthday with live music, history, and family fun at the historic North Carolina State Capitol.
events.description: This free all-day festival marks the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence with performances by Tift Merritt and Rissi Palmer, living history exhibits, food trucks, and an Independence Day ceremony.

events.name: Raleigh's Fourth of July Fireworks
events.tagline: A spectacular fireworks show over Dix Park with music, food, and family fun for America's 250th anniversary.
events.description: Raleigh's annual Fourth of July fireworks celebration returns to Dix Park for the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence, featuring live music, food vendors, activities, and a major fireworks display at 9:30 PM.

events.name: Cary Presents: Independence Day Celebration
events.tagline: Celebrate America's 250th Anniversary with the North Carolina Symphony, patriotic festivities, and a spectacular fireworks show.
events.scheduleNote: Gates open 3:30 PM · Fireworks 9:25 PM · DJ Bri Dance Party 9:55 PM
events.freeNote: General Admission lawn is FREE and does not require a ticket
events.description: This cherished Triangle tradition honors America's 250th Anniversary with performances by the North Carolina Symphony and Cary Town Band, festive activities for kids, and a dazzling fireworks display over Symphony Lake.

events.name: Brier Creek Star Spangled Block Party 2026
events.tagline: Celebrate Independence Day with DJ Mark McNally, family fun, and one of the area’s largest fireworks shows synced to Kix 102.9.
events.description: The annual Star Spangled Block Party at Brier Creek Commons features live DJ music, kids’ activities, patriotic giveaways, and a choreographed fireworks show that begins after dark.

events.name: North Carolina Courage vs. Seattle Reign
events.tagline: Supergirl Night: A fun, family-friendly NWSL match with games, food trucks, and merchandise!
events.description: The North Carolina Courage host the Seattle Reign for Supergirl Night at WakeMed Soccer Park in a fun, family-friendly NWSL match featuring games, food trucks, and merchandise.

events.name: Darren Brand
events.tagline: Big Baby brings wild laughter to Raleigh for a two-night comedy showdown.
events.description: Darren Brand, known as Big Baby, performs his 'Wild ’N Out' comedy show at Goodnights Comedy Club on July 4–5, 2026.

events.name: Fourth on First Avenue
events.tagline: Celebrate Independence Day with a bike parade, live music, food trucks, and family fun at Knightdale Station Park.
events.description: Fourth on First Avenue is Knightdale's annual Independence Day celebration featuring a bike parade, live music by Liquid Pleasure, food trucks, inflatables, axe throwing, and a splash pad party.

events.name: Free Hot Dog Cookout: America's 250th Birthday
events.tagline: Celebrate America's 250th birthday with free hot dogs and a grill-fired cookout at The Davie.
events.address: 444 S. Blount St., Ste. 101, Raleigh, NC 27601
events.description: The Davie hosts a free Hot Dog Cookout on Saturday, July 4, 2026, from noon to 2 a.m. to celebrate America's 250th birthday with free hot dogs and no purchase required.

events.name: Hair in Concert: Peace and Love on America's 250th
events.tagline: Celebrate America's 250th birthday with live music, spoken word, and selections from the musical Hair at this free Independence Day event.
events.description: This free Independence Day celebration features live music, spoken word by North Carolina Poet Laureate Dasan Ahanu, and selections from the musical Hair at Fred Fletcher Park. Families can enjoy hands-on children's activities, improv comedy, opera, puppet theatre, and local food trucks.

events.name: Art & More in the Park 2026
events.tagline: Children of all ages create patriotic-themed crafts and decorate cupcakes at this free community art event.
events.description: Hosted by the Wake Forest Woman's Club and Wake Forest Fire Department, this event offers children the chance to make patriotic crafts and enjoy cupcake decorating inside the Community House and in the adjacent gravel parking lot.

events.name: Cary Independence Day Fishing Tournament 2026
events.tagline: Catch the longest or shortest fish and win prizes in this all-ages Independence Day tournament at Bond Park.
events.venue: Fred G. Bond Metro Park and Boathouse
events.description: The Town of Cary hosts its annual Independence Day Fishing Tournament at Fred G. Bond Metro Park, where anglers of all ages compete for prizes based on the longest and shortest fish caught in each age group.

events.name: Rolesville 4th Celebration
events.tagline: Celebrate Independence Day with live music, food trucks, inflatables, and a spectacular fireworks display.
events.scheduleNote: Sat 5–9:30 PM · Inflatables shut down at 8 PM · Fireworks at 9:15 PM
events.description: The Rolesville 4th Celebration is a free Fourth of July event featuring food trucks, beer and wine vendors, local vendors, inflatables, yard games, live music, and fireworks at Redford Place Park.

events.name: Children's Parade 2026
events.tagline: All area youngsters invited to ride bikes or wagons in a walking parade just for them!
events.venue: Wake Forest Historical Museum/Heritage High School
events.address: 414 N Main St, Wake Forest, NC 27587
events.description: The annual Children's Parade is part of Wake Forest's July 4th celebration, inviting kids to join a walking parade on bicycles or wagons with no registration required.

events.name: "Together, We Are America" | July 4th Celebration
events.tagline: A day-long Independence Day celebration in Hillsborough featuring live music, demos, craft and food vendors, kids’ activities, and a laser light show.
events.description: Presented by the Town of Hillsborough and Orange County, this free Fourth of July festival celebrates community, history, and culture with acoustic music, clogging, a live reading of the Declaration of Independence, a parade, norteño and brass bands, jazz, gospel, and an Independence Day laser light show.

events.name: 2026 July 4th Celebration of America's 250th Birthday!
events.tagline: Chapel Hill joins the nation to celebrate America's 250th birthday with community festivities at Horace Williams House.
events.description: This community event in Chapel Hill celebrates the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence with local festivities at Horace Williams House.

events.name: Annual Reading of Frederick Douglass' Essay
events.tagline: A community gathering to read Frederick Douglass' historic essay on the Fourth of July.
events.description: The Town of Carrboro hosts its annual community reading of Frederick Douglass' essay 'The Meaning of the Fourth of July for the Negro' at the Carrboro Century Center.

events.name: Carrboro July 4th Celebration
events.tagline: Live music, a People's Parade, and family fun for Independence Day in Carrboro.
events.scheduleNote: 9:30–11:00 AM Kick-off at Weaver Street Market · 10:50 AM People's Parade · 11:00–1:30 PM Main event at Town Commons · 2:00–4:00 PM Community Reading at Century Center
events.description: The Town of Carrboro hosts its annual Independence Day celebration featuring live music by Liquid Pleasure, a People's Parade led by the Bulltown Strutters, and family activities including a baby crawl and pie-eating contests.

events.name: Chapel Hill July 4th Drone Show
events.tagline: Technology meets creativity as 300 synchronized drones paint the Chapel Hill sky for America's 250th anniversary.
events.scheduleNote: Sat 7–9:45 PM · Drone show starts 9:20 PM
events.description: Chapel Hill replaces its traditional fireworks with a sustainable drone show featuring 300 synchronized drones creating shapes and images above Chapel Hill High School on July 4, 2026.

events.name: Revolutionary Era Walking Tour
events.tagline: Step into history with a guided walking tour of Hillsborough's Revolutionary War sites.
events.description: Join a guided walking tour exploring Hillsborough's historic district and key sites from the Revolutionary Era, including the Alexander Dickson House and surrounding landmarks.

events.name: July 4th Block Party
events.tagline: Celebrate July 4th with two venues, two unique vibes, and one unforgettable Latin America and America's 250th anniversary block party.
events.description: Join Annexe and High Dive for a dual-venue block party honoring Latin America and America's 250th anniversary, featuring DJ Ek Balam, karaoke, classic films, drink specials, hot dogs, and an ice luge.

events.name: Jireh Family Farm — Farm to Table Breakfast & Farm Tour
events.tagline: Enjoy a buffet-style farm-to-table breakfast with herbal iced tea, coffee, and a 30-minute farm tour.
events.description: Jireh Family Farm hosts its annual Farm to Table Breakfast featuring a buffet of farm-fresh eggs, bacon, sausage, biscuits, hashbrowns, and fried apples, followed by an optional 30-minute farm tour.

events.name: Children's Independence Day Parade
events.tagline: Kick off your Fourth of July with a joyful morning parade of decorated bikes and wagons at Durham Central Park.
events.description: Bring the whole family to Durham Central Park on Saturday, July 4, 2026, for the annual Children's Independence Day Parade featuring bike decorations, balloon fun, and a parade starting at 10:00 AM.

events.name: 77th Annual Watts-Hillandale Fourth of July Parade and Celebration
events.tagline: Durham's oldest Fourth of July celebration kicks off with a historic neighborhood parade at 10 a.m.
events.description: The 77th Annual Watts-Hillandale Fourth of July Parade and Celebration is Durham's longest-running Independence Day event, featuring a neighborhood parade starting at 10 a.m. at Oval Drive Park.

events.name: ADF Children's Matinee: Mark Morris Dance Group and Music Ensemble
events.tagline: A joyful 60-minute dance matinee for kids ages 3+ featuring the Mark Morris Dance Group and iconic American composers
events.description: The Mark Morris Dance Group and Music Ensemble present a 60-minute Children's Matinee at Reynolds Industries Theater, recommended for ages 3+, with tickets priced $40–$70.

events.name: Party on Main: 4th of July Block Party in Durham
events.tagline: Celebrate the 4th of July with DJs, food vendors, and a family-friendly block party on West Main Street.
events.description: Party on Main is a free, family-friendly 4th of July block party in Downtown Durham featuring DJs and food vendors on West Main Street between Corcoran and S. Mangum.

events.name: Sun's Out, Buns Out: 4th of July
events.tagline: Hot dogs, cold drinks, and downtown Durham views on the Roof with DJ Rhueb spinning from 7 to 10 PM.
events.venue: The Roof at The Durham Hotel
events.freeNote: No cover, no reservations; food and drink available for purchase
events.description: A rooftop July 4th cookout at The Durham Hotel featuring juicy beef hot dogs, burgers on brioche buns, and DJ Rhueb spinning from 7 to 10 PM with downtown Durham views.

events.name: Holly Springs Salamanders vs. Asheboro Zookeepers
events.tagline: Coastal Plain League baseball showdown on Fourth of July weekend
events.description: The Holly Springs Salamanders face the Asheboro Zookeepers in a Coastal Plain League baseball game at Ting Stadium in Holly Springs on Saturday, July 4, 2026 at 6:30 PM.

events.name: We Gather Anyway
events.tagline: A community cookout celebrating connection across the African diaspora
events.description: We Gather Anyway is a community cookout held at B-Omi Farms in Wendell, North Carolina, celebrating connection across the African diaspora[1]. The event takes place on Saturday, July 4, 2026, from 3:00 PM to 7:00 PM with admission priced at $130[2][3].

events.name: Zebulon Devil Dogz vs. Greenville Yard Gnomes
events.tagline: Celebrate Independence Day with a Coastal Plain League baseball game under the stars.
events.description: The Zebulon Devil Dogz host the Greenville Yard Gnomes for an Independence Day Coastal Plain League baseball game at Five County Stadium in Zebulon.

events.name: Durham Bulls vs. Gwinnett Stripers
events.tagline: Minor league baseball showdown at Durham Bulls Athletic Park
events.description: The Durham Bulls face the Gwinnett Stripers in a minor league baseball game on Friday, July 3, 2026, at 6:45 PM at Durham Bulls Athletic Park.

events.name: Madison Beer - The Locket Tour
events.tagline: Pop star Madison Beer brings her 'The Locket Tour' to Raleigh with special guests Thủy and Lulu Simon.
events.description: Pop artist Madison Beer performs as part of her 'The Locket Tour,' supporting her third studio album *Locket*, released in January 2026, with special guests Thủy and Lulu Simon[1].

events.name: Harry Connick Jr.
events.tagline: An unforgettable night of jazz standards, pop, and New Orleans classics with the Grammy and Emmy Award-winning singer and composer.
events.address: 123 Vivian St / William V. 'Bill' Bell Way
events.scheduleNote: Sun 7:30 PM · Lobby doors open 6:30 PM
events.description: Harry Connick Jr. performs live at DPAC on July 5, 2026, featuring his signature blend of jazz, pop, and New Orleans classics in a single-night concert.

events.name: America's Cookout
events.tagline: A fun, family-friendly community celebration honoring America's 250th anniversary with food, games, and activities.
events.description: America's Cookout is a community celebration hosted by the City of Raleigh to commemorate the 250th anniversary of the United States, featuring games, activities, food, and opportunities to connect with City departments[1][2].

events.name: Day Party Brunch
events.tagline: An elevated Sunday day party with live DJ, all-you-can-eat brunch buffet, and bubbly in a lush garden-inspired setting.
events.description: Join Botanical Lounge for their weekly Day Party Brunch featuring an abundant buffet, live DJ, and one mimosa included with your $32 ticket.

events.name: The Market at NCMA
events.tagline: Shop local makers and enjoy live music at the NC Museum of Art's monthly artist market.
events.description: The Market at NCMA is a monthly local artist market held at the North Carolina Museum of Art featuring fresh makers, live music, and gallery access. Admission is free and all ages are welcome.

events.name: Holly Springs July 5 Independence Day Celebration
events.tagline: Celebrate America's 250th birthday and Holly Springs' 150th anniversary with live music, food trucks, games, and spectacular fireworks.
events.venue: Jefferson L. Sugg Farm at Bass Lake
events.description: This free community celebration kicks off Holly Springs' year-long 150th anniversary with live entertainment, family activities, food trucks, local history exhibits, and fireworks at 9:15 PM.

events.name: Holly Springs Salamanders vs. Morehead City Marlins
events.tagline: A competitive Coastal Plain League baseball showdown on Sunday, July 5, 2026.
events.description: The Holly Springs Salamanders host the Morehead City Marlins in a Coastal Plain League baseball game at North Main Athletic Complex in Holly Springs, NC on Sunday, July 5, 2026 at 5:05 PM[1][5].

events.name: Zebulon Devil Dogz vs. Peninsula Pilots
events.tagline: Catch the Devil Dogz take on the Peninsula Pilots at Five County Stadium!
events.description: The Zebulon Devil Dogz face off against the Peninsula Pilots in an official Coastal Plain League baseball game at Five County Stadium on Sunday, July 5, 2026.

events.name: Jus Once Band
events.tagline: Sunday sundaze at Kore with live music, DJ XL, and food from Better Fork Wit It
events.scheduleNote: Sunday 3–8 PM · Doors open at 3 PM
events.description: Jus Once Band performs with DJ XL at Kore in Durham on Sunday, July 5, 2026, featuring food by Better Fork Wit It and doors opening at 3 PM.

events.name: Intervallum / Dumb Apologies / The Lost View / Arcyria
events.tagline: High-energy rock night featuring grunge, metalcore, and skramz at KINGS.
events.description: An evening of high-energy performances spanning grunge, metalcore, and skramz at KINGS in Downtown Raleigh.

events.name: Sunday DRIFT Rooftop DJ Series
events.tagline: Every Sunday, music drifts from the rooftop on Orange Street as you end your weekend on a high note.
events.description: A weekly rooftop DJ series at The Velvet Hippo featuring rotating DJs from 4–7 PM every Sunday, with no cover charge and a 21+ entry requirement.
